strategy: Market activity score 0–100: 35% relative volume, 30% absolute daily price movement, 20% absolute 5-day movement, 10% absolute 20-day movement, and 5% average dollar liquidity; a modest penalty applies to unusually high 20-day volatility. Main stocks must have 20-day average dollar volume of at least $1 million; penny stocks must be priced $0.05–$10 and have at least $100,000 average daily dollar volume.
